text:
anna (PM): Quick sync: proposing scope shrink for Optimize toolkit alpha — customers consistently ask for actionable batching+caching recs, pragmatic quant profiles, and eval-triggered alerts. Thoughts?

mike (Eng): +1 to narrower scope. Can we split into two drops? Drop1: static advice + quant profiles for Llama-family & mix-of-modes. Drop2: live eval alerts and per-route tuning.

lee (ML): For quant profiles, we'll need representative prompts + perf matrix. I can prep 2 model configs: 8-bit Q4 and 4-bit dynamic for short/long context. Need ~2000 eval cases per model.

sophia (Solutions): From field: two mid-market customers will take Drop1 immediately if we surface a small README + sample SDK call. They need guidance like "safe for hallucination-sensitive flows?"

anna (PM): Good call. Proposed acceptance criteria for Drop1: 1) actionable recs for batch_size and cache TTL for 80/95/99th latency buckets, 2) quant profile recommendations with measured quality delta <= 3% on key evals, 3) sample SDK + quickstart doc. Agree?

mike (Eng): Agree but call out SLOs: Drop1 must not degrade p99 tail by >5ms when applied to dedicated pools. Also need a plan for runtime feature flags so we can rollout per-customer.

lee (ML): For the "quality delta" metric we should pick ROUGE/F1 + a model-agnostic semantic similarity score. I'll draft eval thresholds. Also suggest alert trigger: 5% drop on rolling 1k requests OR +2 sigma of token-error rate.

chris (Product Ops): @deploy-bot can we schedule a canary window? deploy-bot: Canary job created: optimize-alpha-canary-1716634321, runs 24h across us-west-2. Logs to /canaries/optimize-alpha.

sophia (Solutions): Docs ask: include explicit conservative flags customers can set to prefer freshness vs cost. Also a snippet for disabling quant per-route.

anna (PM): Great. Next steps: lee prepares eval thresholds & 2 quant configs by EOD Thu; mike prototypes feature flags + guidance API by Mon; sophia drafts quickstart + customer checklist by Tue. I'll set a follow-up sync Wed 10am PT. Anything else?

mike (Eng): Need to surface estimated cost savings table for sales. I can compute rough unit economics assuming 40% token cost reduction with 4-bit quant and 20% with 8-bit Q4.

lee (ML): Will add a caution: long-context (>4k) clients may see smaller saving; include sample numbers.

sophia (Solutions): I'll pre-warn two customers about potential 1-2% quality drift and ask if they still want early access.

anna (PM): Thanks team. I'll convert this to an RFC and link the checklist. :thumbsup:

sophia (Solutions): :raised_hands:
